worldcombat.skill.recover.summary: The user regenerates its cells: health is paid back tick by tick over a window for up to about 60% of maximum health, more of it the worse the wounds - and it never locks the user in place, so it can keep moving while it heals. Starting a new action, being interrupted or clearing the regenerating effect cuts the remaining healing, keeping only what was already delivered.
worldcombat.skill.recover.use.1: Let the cells work harder when badly hurt
worldcombat.skill.recover.use.2: Trade an unlocked window for a steady restore
worldcombat.skill.recover.description.0: Restores %1$s of maximum health, paid tick by tick across a %2$s window; reaching full health settles early.
worldcombat.skill.recover.description.2: Wind-up %1$s and recovery %2$s, shortened by Speed; the whole window can be walked through, and the wind-up can be interrupted.
worldcombat.skill.recover.stance.steady: Steady regeneration: +0.05 healing and a 1.35x window - slower each tick but a larger total, at the cost of a longer cooldown and a longer exposed window.
worldcombat.skill.recover.stance.quick: Swift regeneration: -0.04 healing and a 0.75x window - faster to pay out with a shorter cooldown, for a gap between blows.
worldcombat.skill.recover.timing: A self move; after %1$s s of wind-up it spends %3$s PP, then recovers for %2$s s and enters a %4$s s cooldown on cast.
worldcombat.skill.recover.growth.0: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.recover.growth.1: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens further to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.recover.preference.ste: On (steady): +0.05 healing and a 1.35x regeneration window (slower each tick, larger total), at 1.08x cooldown and a longer exposed window. Off (swift): -0.04 healing, a 0.75x window and 0.95x cooldown.
The companion starts regenerating below this health ratio; lower endures longer, higher regenerates at the first wound.

A visible enemy inside this distance, or attacking the companion, stops it from starting regeneration (health under half the threshold ignores this to survive); larger retreats further, smaller heals amid the fight.
worldcombat.skill.recover.description.1: While regenerating it restores a small portion every 2 ticks; starting a new action, being interrupted or clearing the regenerating effect (milk or /effect clear) cuts off the remaining healing and keeps only what was already delivered, and it cannot be used at full health.
